**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 15:53
- [FACT] User has been experiencing back problems from their old desk chair.
- [EVENT] User is considering splurging on a high-end ergonomic chair.
- [EVENT] User set up a new queen-sized bed frame yesterday.
- [CHANGE] User got rid of their old college-era futon and replaced it with a new bed frame.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for ergonomic chairs that provide good back support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on upgrading your bed frame! It's great that you're taking steps to prioritize your comfort and health.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Investing in a high-quality chair can make a significant difference in alleviating back problems.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Key features to look for in an ergonomic chair include:
  - Lumbar Support: A chair with a curved backrest that mirrors the natural shape of your spine.
  - Adjustability: Look for a chair with adjustable height, armrests, and tilt mechanisms.
  - Ergonomic Seat: A seat with a waterfall edge and breathable fabric or mesh.
  - Backrest Height and Angle: A backrest that can be adjusted to fit your upper and lower back.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] High-end ergonomic chair recommendations include:
  - Herman Miller Embody Chair
  - Steelcase Leap Chair
  - Ergohuman High-Back Executive Chair
  - Humanscale Freedom Chair
  - IKEA Markus Chair
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Before making a purchase, consider trying chairs in person, reading reviews, and setting a budget.
- [PREFERENCE] User has been trying out some chairs at the office supply store.

  - Audiobooks: Available on platforms like Audible or local library's digital collection.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Choose books that interest you and switch if you get bored to make elliptical time enjoyable.
